people.name: Isaiah
people.line: Prophet during reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah.

translations.web: Hezekiah the king and Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz, prayed because of this, and cried to heaven.
translations.bsb: In response, King Hezekiah and the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz cried out to heaven in prayer,
translations.kjv: And for this cause Hezekiah the king, and the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz, prayed and cried to heaven.
